content:
samir: heads up - customer OrionBio hit 403s for their private deployment and stopped receiving billing webhooks after their security team rolled out a new DMZ policy. opening thread for triage.
ellie: got it. Any request ids or sample responses from their side?
samir: they sent two samples. initial API error: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
x-request-id: 7c9d1b2
```
And later an upstream timeout: 
```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
x-request-id: 7c9d9f7
```
They reported webhooks failing at ~15:24 UTC.
dmitri: 504s + missing outbound webhooks smells like egress/firewall. Did they change NAT or proxy configs?
samir: they confirmed PaloAlto policy push at 15:10 UTC. They provided a route table showing NAT gateway still present but an inline proxy in the DMZ was added.
jordan: check KMS interaction logs. If agent can't reach KMS to unwrap keys we can get token validation 403s. Share any agent/runtime log snippets.
samir: support uploaded runtime snippet showing repeated KMS timeouts: 
```
2026-12-02T15:18:40Z KMS call to kms.private.internal failed: TLS handshake timeout
2026-12-02T15:19:05Z auth: token validation failed for req 7c9d1b2
```
rachel-security: timeline: 15:10 policy push, 15:18 first KMS timeouts, 15:24 webhooks down. Looks correlated. Flagging potential data retention gap for audit logs until we confirm ingest behavior.
ellie: can Ops repro from the customer VPC? they'd allow a supervised jumpbox test.
samir: they spun up a jumpbox. My repro steps from jumpbox: (1) curl private API -> 403; (2) tcpdump on host -> SYNs to kms IP with no reply; (3) traceroute to kms -> stops at DMZ proxy. tcpdump snippet: 
```
15:19:02.456789 IP 10.1.5.8.51122 > 198.51.100.23.443: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, options [mss 1460], length 0
(no response)
```
dmitri: likely the DMZ proxy is performing deny rules or asymmetric routing. Ask them to check NAT translation table and whether proxy is SNATing outbound connections. If responses go back to a different path they'll be dropped.
jordan: also check haproxy / tcp proxy settings - some proxies terminate TLS or do SSL inspection and break mTLS to KMS. If the proxy requires MITM certs, our KMS endpoint TLS will fail.
rachel-security: compliance notes: (A) missing audit logs: we need to determine if logs were generated but not delivered, or never produced. (B) KMS access interruption: confirm whether key material was attempted to be fetched and HSM returned any denial. Please do not share key material in ticket.
ellie: Samir - gather agent + runtime logs for 15:05-15:40 UTC and upload to secure ticket. Capture x-request-ids.
samir: uploaded logs (secure link redacted). Logs confirm TLS handshake timeout to KMS and a couple of token validation 403s that align with KMS failures.
dmitri: remediation plan options: (1) have customer whitelist KMS and audit-ingest IPs on DMZ proxy; (2) create a dedicated egress ENI with explicit SNAT to avoid proxy; (3) configure a VPC endpoint/private link for KMS if supported. For immediate recovery ask them to allow egress to KMS IPs temporarily.
samir: customer agreed to a 20m maintenance window and allowed temporary egress to KMS + audit collector. Ran quick test during window: openssl shows handshake success now and curl to private API returns 200. Example: 
```
$ curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://private.redwood.orion/v1/gen
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-request-id: 7c9da34
```
rachel-security: good. Confirm whether audit logs for 15:10-15:30 are now backfilled or queued. If ingest had errors we need to capture delivery errors and retention window.
jordan: follow-up: capture proxy config and NAT table entries. Look for policies that deny outbound tcp/443 to the KMS subnets or that require SSL inspection for internal services.
ellie: action items: 
- samir: attach final tcpdump + request ids + note about which egress rule was toggled (ETA 1h)
- dmitri: prepare SNAT/NAT checklist and VPC endpoint recommendation doc (ETA 1 business day)
- rachel-security: open compliance incident record for missing audit logs, label P2, request change control ticket from customer (ETA 2h)
- jordan: review proxy settings and write mitigation steps for proxy SSL inspection artifacts (ETA EOD)
samir: customer firewall logs show explicit deny rule applied at 15:10: `deny tcp any 198.51.100.0/24 443 policy-id 112233`. That explains why KMS TLS syns got no reply.
rachel-security: note in compliance incident - change control missing details on that policy. Ask customer for the ticket and approver. Potential requirement: document allowlist for KMS and audit services.
dmitri: long term recommend either (A) VPC private link to KMS, or (B) dedicated NAT with strict egress rules and monitoring, plus webhook retry/backoff configs.
ellie: customer is asking for an RCA and recommended firewall rules. Samir, can you draft a brief RCA stating root cause = DMZ policy blocking egress to KMS/audit endpoints causing token validation failures and webhook delivery interruptions, and remediation = whitelist endpoints + implement VPC endpoint or dedicated egress + update runbook?
samir: will draft RCA and postmortem after we collect the final logs. Customer confirmed service restored after temporary whitelist.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1202-77 (assigned eng-security).
ellie: thanks team. make sure to redact any sensitive ids in postmortem and include required compliance artifacts. Closing loop with customer once RCA posted.
